name: Munier Chowdhury
role: Teacher, Playwright, and Language Movement Intellectual
contribution: He protested the 1952 killings, was imprisoned, and wrote the play “Kabar,” one of the movement's most powerful literary responses.
context: Dhaka University, prison, and progressive cultural politics in the 1950s.
impact: He gave the language movement a lasting dramatic and intellectual form that outlived the immediate confrontation.
